data.headline: Apigee Developer | SAP APIM I CA Layer7 | IBM Connect l WIPRO | ExTCSer | Devops | AWS & GCP Certified | Integration Specialist
data.about:
Skilled in APIGEE, JavaScript, Python, REST API, AWS, Terraform, Developer portal, Layer 7, API Connect, DataPower Maven, Jira, Confluence, SDLC, Agile methodology, Scrum, and SQL.

Having 6+ years of experience in the design, development, testing, and management of REST APIs using APIGEE.

An Enthusiast and a self-motivated person specializing in DevOps across the industry having hands-on experience supporting, automating, and optimizing the working practice leveraging Configuration Management, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, and DevOps processes

API Developer with significant experience in
- Design, develop, configure & troubleshoot API Proxies & Policies using APIGEE Edge.
- Developing API specifications using Swagger/Open API Spec.
- API security authentication & authorization frameworks such as OAuth 2.0, API Keys, Basic HTTP Authentication & TLS/SSL.
- Exposing a SOAP-based backend service as a REST API Proxy with Apigee Edge.
- Setting up of Drupal Developer Portal for service providers to onboard app developers, add API documentation, and customization.
- API Testing using Postman & Apache Jmeter.
- Integration of APIGEE Edge with external tools like Loggly.
- APIGEE Sense.
- Implementing Security, Analytics, Quota Rate limiting, Caching, Logging, KVM, Shared Flows Monetization, and Debugging using Apigee Edge.
- Error Handling using Fault Rules & creating custom error messages.
- Debug API Proxy and trace API Flow in Apigee Edge using Trace Console.
- Extract Variables from XML Payload & JSON Payload in an API.
- Modification of Request & Response Payload.
- Leveraging Apigee to Conditionally Route traffic to different heterogeneous versions of the backend using Route Rules.

Extensive experience in requirement gathering, designing, developing, and deployment of APIs in APIGEE & Mule.

Deployment Management and continuous integration have been my strengths while doing server management tasks with automation.

❖ Build servers using AWS, importing volumes, launching EC2, and RDS, creating security groups, auto-scaling, and load balancers (ELBs) in the defined virtual private connection.
❖ Set up and build AWS infrastructure resources like VPC, S3, Security Group, Auto Scaling, and RDS in Cloud Formation JSON templates.

DevOps: Git, Maven, Selenium, Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes, Ansible.
AWS: Lamda, API Gateway, EC2, Elastic Beanstalk, S3, Route53, IAM, Glacier, Elastic Block Storage, VPC, Auto Scaling, Load Balancer, EFS, Cloudwatch, Cloudfront.

Holds a Master of Computer Application degree from Vellore Institute of Technology - University
